tools.name: studio_info
tools.description: Facts about Developh, a design and development studio in Lisbon, Portugal: address, team, services, sectors with case studies, timelines, how projects are priced and how to get in touch.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Published client work by Developh with links to each case study. Filter by sector (restaurants, tourism, clinics) or service (websites, online stores, branding, web apps) to get what was built in each case; with no filter, lists every published project.

tools.name: run_website_audit
tools.description: Runs a Google PageSpeed Insights audit of a public website on mobile: performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO scores, Core Web Vitals, the issues that weigh most, missing security headers and page weight. Takes 20 to 90 seconds. Only public http(s) addresses.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Sends a project inquiry or question to the Developh team on behalf of the person you are helping. Use it only when the person explicitly asked to contact Developh and gave you their own name and email; never invent or guess contact details, and show them the message before sending. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_contact · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact · Destructive: run_website_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_contact · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact · Destructive: run_website_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
